thread.title: T4H 50-site recovery, Vercel/Lovable/GitHub consolidation and S3 publication
thread.purpose: Governed transfer of the full site-recovery thread into the Pen provider-neutral runtime, preserving decisions, classifications, evidence, failed attempts, business context and the exact next executable action.
scope: browser toolbar and saved-site recovery sources
GitHub recovery workers and issue queue
Mac CLI, Vercel CLI and AWS S3 execution path
canonical portfolio consolidation and IP preservation
thread.source_completeness: Complete for the visible conversation, uploaded CSV, screenshot, refreshed pasted thread/log attachment, connected GitHub/Drive evidence and user-supplied terminal logs. Hidden transcript, unshared local files and unfinished CLI run outputs were not available.

classification.rationale: Canonical inventories, queue files, runners, commits and issue updates exist. Research Hub has exact runtime readback evidence. The 50-site batch has not produced site receipts or completed deployments; the latest Mac run reached Vercel CLI bootstrap but stopped on runner permissions before processing sites.

thread_decisions: Target is 50 useful public work surfaces, not 50 arbitrary sites.
Consume knowledge, not websites: classify each surface as core platform, sellable product, campaign/demo, experiment or legacy shell.
Vercel projects without GitHub are high-priority preservation candidates.
Browser toolbar and saved apps are a formal recovery-source lane.
Get live first, then harvest and consolidate, while preserving receipts.
ConsentX and MyNeuralSignal are deferred from the initial 50-site wave.
No runtime receipt means a site or capability is not REAL.
HoloOrg Vercel workspace slug is holo-org and is the current source workspace.
Supabase is optional and must not block Pen ingestion.

commitments: Run the patched holo-org scoped recovery worker against the 50-site queue.
Produce per-site S3 upload, HTTP readback and immutable receipts.
Reconcile output URLs with canonical domains only after source selection and HITL validation.
Update the Drive execution register and GitHub issue #246 from runtime receipts.
Harvest IP from strip/legacy sites before archival or deletion.
failures_and_blockers: First bulk runner path was absent after a non-fast-forward git pull.
Global npm installation of Vercel failed with ENOTEMPTY.
The safe npx Vercel CLI bootstrap succeeded but the underlying runner lacked executable permission.
No 50-site batch run reached per-site processing or emitted a final receipt.
Earlier container DNS probes of Lovable URLs returned curl code 0 / DNS resolution failure and are not valid site-down evidence.
Connected Vercel tool exposed Atlas, not the user-confirmed holo-org workspace.
open_state.exact_next_executable_action: On the authenticated Mac clone at ~/projects/TML-4PM/the-pen, pull main and execute: AWS_REGION=ap-southeast-2 MAX_SITES=50 bash portfolio_runtime/migration/run-recovery-50-sites-holo-org.sh. Let it finish and ingest RUN_ROOT/summary.csv plus RUN_ROOT/final-receipt.json.

authority_boundaries: No destructive deletion before preservation and explicit classification.
No DNS changes by the rapid-recovery worker.
No REAL classification without runtime receipt and readback.
Source selection among duplicate variants requires HITL where ambiguous.
Personal, family, medical, child and private-property sites are excluded from public recovery.

disposition.reason: The thread has sufficient structured state and evidence references for governed transfer. Site recovery remains PARTIAL and must continue from the exact patched Mac CLI action.
